category_edits.rationale: Test L2-normalized tied item embeddings under the current pointwise logistic objective across all four datasets. Normalize sequence, target and candidate lookups with epsilon 1e-8 and exactly zero padding. Preserve input scaling, positions, causal convolutions, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so inference uses identical normalization with unchanged checkpoint shapes and one model per category.

change_summary: L2-normalize all tied item embedding lookups with zero padding across all four category models. The existing predictor writer imports the updated class, preserving training and inference consistency.
